tools.name: slowhop_search
tools.description: Search slowhop.com, the Polish marketplace of 'slow' stays: houses and cabins in nature, agritourism, guesthouses, glamping, tiny houses and apartments with character, mostly in Poland (some in Czechia, Slovakia, Italy, Croatia…). Filter by place (region, town, country or a landscape word), check-in

tools.name: slowhop_place
tools.description: Full details of one slowhop.com place: type, summary, highlights and the host's description (Polish), address and coordinates, setting, rating and recent reviews, every unit (house/room/tent: capacity, area, rooms and beds, pets accepted), check-in/out times and quiet hours, house rules, pets policy
